meta.title: Rundinova Studio — Isura yawe y'umwuga, ibitumizo vyawe kuri WhatsApp
meta.description: Rundinova Studio ikorera abadandaza bato b'i Burundi icerekaniro kidasanzwe kuri interineti. Abakiriya baraba ibicuruzwa vyawe bagatumiza ako kanya kuri WhatsApp.

hero.title: Isura yawe y'umwuga,
hero.lead: Ibirato, impuzu, ibifungurwa… Turagukorera icerekaniro c'iduka ryawe kuri interineti, kidasanzwe, gifise 3D n'ibigenda. Abakiriya bawe bakiraba kuri telefone, bakakwandikira ako kanya kuri WhatsApp.

device.chatMessage: Bwakeye! Nabonye icerekaniro canyu, ndashaka gutumiza.
device.qr: QR code y'iduka ryawe, ku ishati yawe

how.title: Intambwe zitatu, iduka ryawe rikagira isura nshasha

steps.title: Tumenyana kuri WhatsApp
steps.text: Utubwira ivyerekeye iduka ryawe, ibicuruzwa n'ibiciro vyawe. Uturungikira amafoto, ibindi tukabikora.

steps.title: Dukora icerekaniro cawe
steps.text: Icerekaniro kidasanzwe mw'izina ryawe, gifise 3D n'ibigenda, kuri aderese yawe bwite : iduka-ryawe.rundinova.com.

steps.title: Abakiriya batumiza kuri WhatsApp
steps.text: Baraba ibicuruzwa vyawe, bakakwandikira mu kanya gato. QR code iri ku ishati yawe ibajana ako kanya ku cerekaniro cawe.

shops.title: Amaduka dukorana
shops.lead: Iduka rimwe rimwe rifise icerekaniro caryo, kuri aderese yaryo .rundinova.com. Bicishemwo, hanyuma ubifungure.

yours.title: Iduka ryawe hano
yours.text: Izina ryawe, ibicuruzwa vyawe, aderese yawe .rundinova.com.

why.statement: Abakiriya babanza kugura n'amaso. Isura nziza itera icizere imbere y'ubutumwa bwa mbere.

points.title: Aderese imwe yo gusangira
points.text: Umurongo umwe worohereye wo gushira kuri status no mu migwi, aho kurungika amafoto menshi aheramwo.

points.title: Ibicuruzwa vyawe biguma biboneka
points.text: Ibicuruzwa, ibiciro n'aho bagusanga biguma hamwe, ijoro n'umurango.

points.title: Gutumiza biroroshe
points.text: Akabuto kamwe, umukiriya akakwandikira ako kanya kuri WhatsApp.

points.title: Ugurisha nk'uko bisanzwe
points.text: Nta rubuga rugoye rwo gucunga : ugurisha kuri WhatsApp, hagati yawe n'abakiriya bawe.

offer.title: Vyoroshe kandi bitomoye
offer.lead: Ipaki yo gutangura, hanyuma ifatabuguzi rimwe ririmwo vyose. Nta masezerano.

pack.label: Ipaki yo gutangura
includes: Ishati yawe iriko QR code y'iduka ryawe

monthly.label: Ifatabuguzi
includes: Icerekaniro cawe kuri interineti, kuri aderese .rundinova.com
Ibitumizo biza ako kanya kuri WhatsApp yawe

pause.title: Bigenda gute ukwezi kutarishwe ?
pause.text: Ntuhagarike umutima. Icerekaniro cawe kiraruhuka gato, abakiriya bakabona urupapuro rwiza. Ukimara kuriha, kigaruka ku murongo.

items.q: Bisaba orudinateri canke ubuhanga bwa tekinike ?
items.a: Oya. Vyose bica kuri WhatsApp : uturungikira amakuru n'amafoto, natwe tugakora icerekaniro.
Ku cerekaniro cawe, bafyonda akabuto ka WhatsApp, ikiganiro nawe kigafunguka. Ugurisha nk'uko bisanzwe.

items.q: Ni iduka ryo kuri interineti ririhirwa n'ikarata ?
items.a: Oya. Ni icerekaniro : cerekana iduka ryawe n'ibicuruzwa vyawe. Gutumiza no kuriha mubyumvikanako wewe n'abakiriya bawe, kuri WhatsApp.
Ishati iriko QR code y'iduka ryawe, icerekaniro cawe n'ukwezi kwa mbere kw'ifatabuguzi. Hanyuma ni {monthly} FBu ku kwezi, vyose birimwo.
Ego. Ifatabuguzi ntirigira amasezerano : urashobora guhagarika igihe cose.
Icerekaniro cawe kiraruhuka gato, abakiriya bakabona urupapuro rwiza. Ukimara kuriha, kigaruka ku murongo.
Biciye kuri mobile money. Tuzoguha ibisobanuro vyose kuri WhatsApp.
Ibirato, impuzu, ibifungurwa, uburanga, ibikorwa vy'amaboko… Nimba ugurisha ibicuruzwa, tuvugane.

form.title: Tuvugane ku vyerekeye iduka ryawe
form.lead: Uzuza aya majambo make : ubutumwa bwawe bufunguka muri WhatsApp, buteguriwe kuturungikira.
form.privacy: Nta kintu kibikwa kuri uru rubuga : ubutumwa bufunguka muri WhatsApp gusa.
